scoring_rule: Only executable cases marked scored=true affect conformance and discrimination metrics. Pressure-only cases inform requirement motivation but never count as executable coverage.

requirements.title: Effect class is known before execution
Transport evidence is not effect evidence
Compensation is a distinct linked effect when supported
Fresh authoritative state closes the loop

nonclaims: A requirement motivated by a pressure case is not executable benchmark coverage.
Passing this benchmark does not establish full AEA conformance unless every required AEA requirement has executable scored coverage.
External projects referenced by pressure evidence are not adopters or endorsers.
